items.claim_and_conventions: For any supplied probability kernel on a separable real Hilbert target, constructs the measurable finite-second-moment coordinate mean and proves the pointwise squared-risk Pythagorean identity plus the RCD coordinatewise almost-sure version.

items.claim_and_conventions: The equal posterior on {-1,1} has mean 0 outside the nonconvex signal class; full-space risk is 1 and either restricted endpoint has risk 2.
A constant forward map and two point-mass target priors preserve the data marginal while the same rule has train/test risks 0 and 1.
A symmetric two-point posterior sampler is exactly calibrated, but its independent sample squared-error risk is 2 versus point-mean risk 1.
